decisions.reason: The illustrated release series remains aligned with the firm's curated niche, and though results are still uncertain, organizational slack allows carrying it while monitoring performance against aspirations.
The jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm's core vinyl/curation strength and likely performs above aspirations, so little problemistic search is triggered.
The multi-disc box set is close to established collector-oriented products and likely meets aspirations, but higher inventory costs keep some risk, and slack supports carrying it.
The compilation CD is close to established, but CD decline and the earlier drop of a similar compilation raise uncertainty; slack allows keeping it while evaluating alternatives.
